title: Root To Leaf Path Sum
statement:
Check whether any root-to-leaf path in a binary tree adds up to a target total.

Contract
- `root` may be null. An empty tree has no root-to-leaf paths and returns false.
- A path must start at the root and end at a leaf, where a leaf has no children.
- Node values and `target` may be negative. Return true if at least one complete root-to-leaf path has the requested sum.

Examples
`hasPathSum(tree(5, 4, 8, 11, null, 13, 4, 7, 2), 22)` => `true`
`hasPathSum(tree(1, 2, 3), 5)` => `false`
`hasPathSum(null, 0)` => `false`
hints: Subtract the current node value from the remaining target as you descend.
Only accept the sum when the current node is a leaf.
A depth-first search can short-circuit once either child finds a valid path. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(h) stack space.
inputSyntax: Input: target followed by the tree in level order with null for missing children, for example: 22 [5, 4, 8, 11, null, 13, 4, 7, 2]
